title: Kab aaoge maula
body:
Kab aaoge maula
Jaage hue fitno ko sulane chale aao..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
ab beet gaye kitne zamane chale aao
1. 1100 baras kese guzare mere aaqa..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaibat me jo guzri hai sunane chale aao
kab aaoge maula..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jab aana ho aajana magar khwaab me mere
kab aaoge maula..(2) ye batane chale aao
<<DIVIDER>>
kab aaoge maula..
3. Ye matami hai ye hai namazi ye koi aur..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
in saari fasilo ko girane chale aao
kab aaoge maula..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ho qadir e mutlaq ki tumhi aakhri hujjat..(2)
majbooro ko mukhtar banane chale aao
<<DIVIDER>>
kab aaoge maula..
5. Har samt rawa hai abu sufiyan ka sikka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
sikka abu talib ka..(2) chalane chale aao
kab aaoge maula..
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ghaazi ka alam aapke lashkar ka nisha hai..(2)
kaabe pe ise maula sajane chale aao..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
kab aaoge maula..
7. Armaan hai ghaibat se sada aae ke sibte..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
jafar zara ash'aar sunane chale aao
kab aaoge maula..
<<DIVIDER>>
kab aaoge maula ye batane chale aao
author: Mir Hassan Mir
